title: Topic 19
japanese_text: 将来の<u>ビジョン</u>がはっきりせず、向いている職業も分からないので、インターネットで<u>適性</u>診断を受けた。結果は「あなたの長所は<u>視野</u>が広いところ。でも、人に<u>指図される</u>のは嫌みたい。そんなあなたは社長が向いてる！」というもので、<u>思い当たる</u>節があると思い、早速<u>起業セミナー</u>に申し込んだ。
english_translation: I took an online aptitude test because I didn't have a clear vision for my future and didn't know what occupation I was suited for. The result was: "One of your strengths is your broad perspective. But you don't like to be ordered around. You are suited to be a CEO!" That rung a bell with me, and I immediately signed up for a seminar on entrepreneurship.

annotated_words.meaning_en: come to mind, ring a bell
